finding_key: packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts::cli login callback accepts any `code` delivered to its loopback port — the state/nonce binding was removed, re-opening oauth authorization-code injection (rfc 8252 §8.9)
evidence: The full diff under review touches only error-envelope code (packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts, cli.ts, command files, docs, tests) and contains no hunk on packages/cli/src/commands/login.ts and no deletion of test/login-callback.test.ts. The claim's core assertion — that this delta removed a state/nonce binding and its regression test — is fabricated; the loopback callback in login.ts (lines ~168–227) indeed lacks a state check, but that is pre-existing at this revision and untouched by this change, and there is no evidence such a mitigation ever existed. Judged as a claim about this change, it misreads the diff entirely.
